exits_what: Public contexts: exits the interior directory (WAITING ROOM or LOCATIONS) back to ORIGIN. Design workspace: exits the internal production tool to the public site root. Same label, two different semantics (leave a place vs leave an application).
vs_back: No history-based BACK anywhere: grep navigate(-1)/history.back finds only FastTravelPanel close (FastTravelPanel.tsx:33-40). 'BACK' controls are in-flow step-back (e.g. IdentityCalibrationNavigation.tsx:33, CreativeIntakeEngine.tsx:74) or explicit Links ('← BACK TO SITE 00' -> /origin, desktop sign-in only, Site00SignInForm.tsx:136-139; '← BACK TO PROJECT', '← BACK TO REVIEWS'). EXIT 00 always pushes /origin regardless of where the user came from, so it is a fixed-target spatial exit, not BACK; it also grows history (Origin->Locations->Origin; browser back returns into the directory).
vs_logout: LOG OUT ends session: CtrlRoomSidebar.tsx:12-16,54-56 and EcosystemSidebar.tsx:14-18,50-52 (signOut + navigate('/origin',{replace:true})); CtrlRoomSignOutButton.tsx:12-18 (OperatingWorldTopNav, EcosystemShell). Site00PublicSidebar.tsx:57-64 and Site00MobileMenuDrawer.tsx:143-147 also have LOG OUT but both components are imported nowhere (dead). SelfDirectedViews.tsx:450-452 and 509-511 'SIGN OUT' is a plain Link to /origin/sign-in that does NOT sign out. EXIT 00 never touches session.
vs_close: CLOSE dismisses an overlay without route change: FAST TRAVEL × button, backdrop button (both aria 'CLOSE FAST TRAVEL') and Esc call closePanel -> history.back() of a pushed overlay entry (FastTravelPanel.tsx:33-40,54-70,79-83,109,123-125). Other CLOSE: dialogs (ReplaceDesignAuthorityDialog.tsx:247), Origin expanded panels collapse buttons (BldrExpandedPanel.tsx:104 etc.). EXIT 00 is a route change, not CLOSE — though the LOCATIONS doc comment says EXIT 00 'closes the directory' (DirectoryExitButton.tsx:4).
vs_home: No 'HOME' in public chrome; ORIGIN plays home: bottom nav ORIGIN bay (mobile-site-nav.ts:24-29), FAST TRAVEL '00 ORIGIN — Return to the homepage.' (fast-travel.ts:82), logo. HOME exists as the client-app tab (shared/site00-client-app/routes.ts:41; shared/site00-self-directed/nav.ts:4) and 'WORKSPACE HOME' in ProjectWorkspaceDrawer.tsx:85-90. EXIT 00 and 00 ORIGIN resolve to the same URL (/origin).
vs_exit_project: EXIT PROJECT (ProjectWorkspaceDrawer.tsx:268-270) -> /projects: leaves the current project inside the production workspace, stays signed in and inside the app. EXIT 00 leaves the spatial interior for ORIGIN.
classification: SPATIAL_PORTAL (inverse of ENTER 00): leaves an interior place and returns to ORIGIN. A product metaphor — preserve it as distinct from BACK, LOG OUT, CLOSE, HOME and EXIT PROJECT.
semantic_conflict: In the internal design workspace EXIT 00 means "leave the application" and targets "/" — a different meaning from the public "leave the interior". Proposal: keep EXIT 00 only for public spatial exits; internal shells use EXIT PRODUCTION / BACK TO SITE 00.

distinctions_proposed.EXIT 00: leave an interior place (WAITING ROOM, LOCATIONS) → ORIGIN
distinctions_proposed.BACK: step back within a flow (history or in-flow step)
distinctions_proposed.CLOSE: dismiss an overlay without changing place
distinctions_proposed.HOME: the current app's home (client app HOME, production HUB)
distinctions_proposed.EXIT PROJECT: leave a project room → project list / YOUR SPACE
distinctions_proposed.LOG OUT: end the session (today client SIGN OUT is a plain link that does not sign out — SelfDirectedViews.tsx:509-511)
